title: ArmoStatusHud
description: A lightweight HUD mod that displays your armor status at a glance, keeping you informed without cluttering your screen.
body:
## ArmoStatusHud

**ArmoStatusHud** adds a clean, lightweight HUD element that displays the durability of your equipped armor pieces in real time — no more opening your inventory to check if your gear is about to break!

### Features
- Shows durability for helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots
- Color-coded bar (green → yellow → red) so you can spot damaged armor at a glance
- Minimal, non-intrusive design that fits any UI setup
- Zero configuration needed — works right out of the box

### Why use it?
Keeping track of armor durability manually is tedious, especially during long exploration or combat sessions. ArmoStatusHud keeps this information always visible, helping you avoid unexpected armor breakage at the worst possible moment.
